newsitem.title: USA: Amoco says may sell Texas pipeline unit.
newsitem.headline: Amoco says may sell Texas pipeline unit.

text.p: Amoco Corp said it may sell its intrastate natural gas pipeline unit in Texas that serves customers in the Houston Ship Channel and Texas City areas.

The Texas City-based unit, known as Amoco Gas Co, has natural gas sales of about 650 million cubic feet of gas per day (mmcf) on its 380-mile pipeline system and processes over 2,500 barrels per day of natural gas liquids.

The unit's main business involves purchase and resale of natural gas, marketing of gas supply and transportation services and operation of its pipeline, storage facility and natural gas liquids plant assets.
Amoco Gas Co employs about 65 people, Amoco said.

"This strategic review marks another example of Amoco's aggressive portfolio management strategy aimed at focusing its upstream business on core assets and growth areas worldwide," said Rebecca McDonald, group vice president with Amoco's exploration and production business.

"This pipeline unit may be a better strategic fit for another company ... Consistent with Amoco's commitment to a more focused, financially superior U.S. upstream asset base, it is appropriate to review our ownership," she said.
Amoco said it hired Lazard Freres as financial advisor to assist in the strategic review.
